English: We studied the incidence of and risk factors for various types of cancers in adolescents and young adults living with HIV (AYALWH) in South Africa between 2004 and 2014.
Luganda: Twanoonyereza ku bika bya kookolo eby’enjawulo n’ebimuleeta mu bavubuka abalina HIV mu South Afirika wakati wa 2004 ne 2014.
Yoruba: A ṣèwádìí ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àti okùnfà ewu fún oríṣiríṣi àwọn ààrùn jẹjẹrẹ láàrin àwọn ọ̀dọ́ àti àwọn àgbà kéékèèké tí ó ń gbé pẹ̀lú HIV (AYALWH) ní orílẹ̀-èdè South Africa láàrin ọdún 2004 àti ọdún 2014.
Zulu: Sicwaninge isigameko zobungozi nomthelela wezinhlobo zemidlavuza kwabathombayo nabasha abaphila ne-HIV (AYALWH) eNingizimu Afrika phakathi kuka-2004 no 2014.
Hausa: Mun yi nazarin abubuwan da suka faru da abubuwan haɗari ga nau'ikan ciwon daji daban-daban a cikin matasa da matasa masu fama da cutar HIV (AYALWH) a Afirka ta Kudu tsakanin 2004 da 2014.
Northern Sotho: Re dirile dinyakišišo ka ga tiragalo le dintlha tša dikotsi tša mehuta ye e fapafapanego ya dikankere go bana ba go tšwa mahlalagading le baswa bao ba phelago ka HIV (AYALWH) ka Afrika Borwa magareng ga 2004 le 2014.
Amharic: ከ2004 እስከ 2014 በደቡብ አፍሪካ ኤችአይቪ ያለባቸው ታዳጊ ጎረምሶች እና ጎልማሶች (ኤ.ያ.ታ.ጎ.ጎ) ላይ የተለያዩ የካንሰር አይነቶች መከሰትን እና የአደጋ መንሰኤዎችን አጥንተናል፡፡

English: We included individuals aged 15 to 24 years from the South African HIV Cancer Match study, a large cohort resulting from a linkage between HIV-related laboratory measurements from the National Health Laboratory Services and records from the National Cancer Registry.
Luganda: Twateekamu abantu ab’emyaka 15 ku 24 okuva mu South African HIV Cancer Match study, nga kino kibinja ekinene ekyava mu nkolagana wakati w’ebipimo by’amagezeserezo agakwata ku HIVokuva mu National Health Laboratory Services n’ebiwandiiko okuva mu National Cancer Registry.
Yoruba: A ṣàfikún ọjọ́-orí 15 sí 24 nínú ìwádìí àpawọ́pọ̀ṣe lórí HIV àti jẹjẹrẹ ní orílẹ̀-èdè South Africa, ẹ̀gbé tó tóbi tí ó jẹ́ àyọrísí ìsopọ̀ láàrin òsùwon àyẹ̀wò ajẹmọ́-HIV láti ilé-iṣẹ́ ibùdó àyẹ̀wò ètò-ìlera àpapọ̀ orílẹ̀-èdè àti ibùdó àpapọ̀ àkọsílẹ̀ ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ jẹjẹrẹ.
Zulu: Sifake abaneminyaka ewu-15 kuya ku-24 abavela ocwaningweni lwe-South African HIV Cancer Match, iqoqo elikhulu elivela ekuxhumaneni kwezilinganiso ezivela kumalaborethri ahambisana ne-HIV avela e-National Health Laboratory Services namarekhodi ase-National Cancer Registry(Inqolobane yomdlavuza).
Hausa: Mun haɗa da daidaikun mutane masu shekaru 15 zuwa 24 daga binciken Match na Cutar Kanjamau na Afirka ta Kudu, babban ƙungiyar da ta samo asali daga alaƙa tsakanin ma'aunin dakin gwaje-gwaje masu alaƙa da HIV daga Sabis na Laboratory Health na Ƙasa da kuma bayanan daga rajistar cutar kansa ta ƙasa.
Northern Sotho: Re akareditše batho ba mengwaga ye 15 go fihla go 24 go tšwa go dinyakišišo tša South African HIV Cancer Match, e lego sehlopha se segolo seo se hlotšwego ke kamano magareng ga dikelo tša laporathori tše di amanago le HIV go tšwa go National Health Laboratory Services le dipego tša go tšwa go National Cancer Registry.
Amharic: በደቡብ አፍሪካ የኤችአይቪ ካንሰር ማች ጥናት ከ15-24 ዓመት ያሉ ሰዎችን አካተናል፤ ከብሄራዊ የጤና ላብራቶሪ ሰርቪስ እና ከብሄራዊ ካንሰር ሬጅስትሪ ከኤችአይቪ ጋር በተያያዙ የላብራቶሪ ልኬቶች ሰፊ ስብስቦች ተገኝተዋል፡፡

English: We computed incidence rates for the most common cancers.
Luganda: Twabala emiwendo gy’abafuna ebika bya kookolo ebisinga okulabika.
Yoruba: A ṣàkọsílẹ̀ ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àwọn jẹjẹrẹ tí ó wọ́pọ̀ jùlọ.
Zulu: Siqoqele ndawonye ukuvela kwemidlavuza ejwayelekile.
Hausa: Mun ƙididdige yawan faruwan na mafi yawan nau’ikan cutur daji.
Northern Sotho: Re šomišitše khomphutha go hwetša dikelo tša ditiragalo go bontši bja dikankere tše di tlwaelegilego.
Amharic: በጣም ለተለመዱት የካንሰር አይነቶች የክስተት ምጥነቶችን አስልተናል፡፡

English: We assessed associations between these cancers and sex, age, calendar year, and CD4 cell count using Cox models and adjusted hazard ratios (aHR).
Luganda: Twekenneenya obukwatane wakati wa kookolo ono n’ekikula, emyaka, omwaka, n’omuwendo gw’obutaffaali bwa CD4 nga tukozesa enkola za Cox n’omuwendo gw’obulabe (aHR).
Yoruba: A wo ìkanra láàrin àwọn jẹjẹrẹ náà àti ẹ̀yà-ìbí, ọdún ìbí, àti iye kuulu-ẹ̀jẹ̀ CD4 pẹ̀lú ìṣàmúlò módẹ́ẹ̀lì Cox àti òṣùwòn alátúntò ásáàdì (aHR).
Zulu: Sihlolisise ukuhlangana phakathi kwalemidlavuza nocansi, iminyaka, unyaka, nesibalo samasosha e-CD4 ngamamodeli e-Cox nama-adjusted hazard ratios (aHR).
Hausa: Mun kimanta alaqa tsakanin waɗannan cututtukan daji da jinsi, shekaru, shekarar kalanda, da ƙididdigar ƙwayoyin CD4 ta amfani da samfuran Cox da daidaita ma'aunin haɗari (aHR).
Northern Sotho: Re lekotše dikamano magareng ga dikankere tše le bong, mengwaga, ngwaga wa khalentara, le kelo ya disele tša CD4 ka tšhomišo ya dimmotlolo tša Cox le dikelo tše di beakantšwego tša dikotsi (aHR).
Amharic: ወሲባዊ ግንኙነት፣ እድሜ፣ የቀን መቁጠሪያ አመትን እና የኮክስ ሞዴሎችን በመጠቀም የተሰላ የሲዲ4 የሴል ቁጥር እና የተስተካከሉ የአደጋ መጠኖች (የ.አ.መ) ከካንሰር ጋር ያላቸውን ግንኙነት ገምግመናል፡፡

English: Of those, 867 developed incident cancer including 429 who developed Kaposi sarcoma, 107 non-Hodgkin lymphoma, 48 Hodgkin lymphoma, 45 cervical cancer, and 32 leukaemia.
Luganda: Ku bano, 867 baafuna kookolo mu kiseera ekyo omuli 429 abaafuna Kaposi sarcoma, 107 abaafuna non-Hodgkin lymphoma, 48 Hodgkin lymphoma, 45 kookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana, ne 32 kookolo w’omusaayi.
Yoruba: Nínú àwọn wọ̀nyìí, 867 jẹ ààrùn jẹjẹrẹ yọ tí ó fi mọ́ 429 tí ó jẹ Kaposi sakóma yọ, aláìní-ọjigin lìkómà 107, ọjigin lìkómà 48, jẹjẹjẹ òbò 45, àti lukémíà 32.
Zulu: Kulabo, u-867 ube nomdlavuza wokuzivelela okubalwa u-429 obe nomdlavuza onesimila i-Kaposi sakhoma, u-107 obe ne-non-Hodgkin limfoma, u-48 ne-Hodgkin limfoma, u-45 nomdlavuza wesibeletho, no-32 nomdlavuza wegazi ilukhimya.
Hausa: Daga cikin waɗancan, 867 sun sami cinwon daji da ya haxa da 429 waɗanda suka sami Kaposi sarcoma, 107 lymphoma ba Hodgkin, lymphoma Hodgkin 48, kansar mahaifa 45, da cutar sankarar bargo 32.
Northern Sotho: Godimo ga bona, basadi ba 867 ba bile le malwetši a kankere go akaretšwa ba 429 bao ba bilego le kankere ya dišo tša ka fase ga letlalo, ba 107 ba bile le kankere ye e sa hlaselego mašole a mmele, ba 48 ba bile le kankere ya go hlasela mašole a mmele, ba 45 ba bile le kankere ya molomo wa popelo, le ba 32 bao ba bilego le kankere ya madi.
Amharic: ከእነዚህ 867 ያህሉ በካንሰር የተያዙ ሲሆን፣ 429 ያህሉ ካፖሲ ሳርኮማ ፣ 107 ያህሉ ናን ሆድጅኪን ሊምፎማ፣ 48 ያህሉ ሆድጅኪን ሊምፎማ፣ 45 ያህሉ የማህጸን በር ካንሰር እና 32 ያህሉ ደግሞ በሉኪሚያ ተይዘው ነበር፡፡

English: Kaposi sarcoma was more common in the 20-24 year age group than the 15-19 year age group (aHR 1.39, 95% CI 1.03-1.86).
Luganda: Kaposi sarcoma ye yasinga okulabika mu kibinja eky’emyaka 20-24 okusinga ku kibinja eky’emyaka 15-19 (aHR 1.39, 95% CI 1.03-1.86).
Yoruba: Kaposi sakóma wọ́pọ̀ lára àwọn ọjọ́ orí 20-24 ju ọjọ́ orí 15-19 lọ (aHR 1.39, 95% CI 1.03-1.86).
Zulu: I-Kaposi sarcoma(umdlavuza onesimila) ibiningi kwabaneminyaka ewu-20 kuya ku-24 kunabaneminyaka ewu-15 kuya ku-19 (aHR 1.39, 95% CI 1.03-1.86).
Hausa: An fi samun Kaposi sarkoma a cikin masu shekaru 20-24 fiye da masu shekaru 15-19 (aHR 1.39, 95% CI 1.03-1.86).
Northern Sotho: Kankere ya dišo tša ka fase ga letlalo e be e atile kudu go sehlopha sa mengwaga ye 20-24 go feta go sehlopha sa mengwaga ye 15-19 (aHR 1.39, 95% CI 1.03-1.86).
Amharic: ከ15-19 እድሜ ክልል ውስጥ ካሉት ቡድኖች ጋር ሲወዳደሩ ከ20-24 አድሜ ክልል ውስጥ ባሉ ሰዎች ላይ ካፖሲ ሳርኮማ በበለጠ ሁኔታ ተከስቶ ነበር፡፡

English: Male sex was associated with higher rates of Kaposi sarcoma (aHR 2.06, 95% CI 1.61-2.63), non-Hodgkin lymphoma (aHR 3.17, 95% CI 2.06-4.89), Hodgkin lymphoma (aHR 4.83, 95% 2.61-8.93), and leukaemia (aHR 5.90, 95% CI 2.87-12.1).
Luganda: Ekikula ekisajja kyakwanyizibwa n’emiwendo egya waggulu egya Kaposi sarcoma (aHR 2.06, 95% CI 1.61-2.63), non-Hodgkin lymphoma (aHR 3.17, 95% CI 2.06-4.89), Hodgkin lymphoma (aHR 4.83, 95% 2.61-8.93), ne kookolo w’omusaayi (aHR 5.90, 95% CI 2.87-12.1).
Yoruba: Ẹ̀yà-ìbí akọ ní Kaposi sakóma lópọ̀ (aHR 2.06, 95% CI 1.61-2.63), aláìní-ọjigin lìkómà (aHR 3.17, 95% CI 2.06-4.89), ọjigin lìkómà (aHR 4.83, 95% 2.61-8.93), àti lukémíà (aHR 5.90, 95% CI 2.87-12.1).
Zulu: Abesilisa bebetholakala benamazinga aphezulu e-Kaposi sakhoma (aHR 2.06, 95% CI 1.61-2.63), non-Hodgkin limfoma (aHR 3.17, 95% CI 2.06-4.89), e-Hodgkin limfoma (aHR 4.83, 95% 2.61-8.93), nomdlavuza wegazi (aHR 5.90, 95% CI 2.87-12.1).
Hausa: Maza sun fi  samun Kaposi sarkoma (aHR 2.06, 95% CI 1.61-2.63), lymphoma wanda ba na Hodgkin ba (aHR 3.17, 95% CI 2.06-4.89), lymphoma na Hodgkin (aHR 4.83, 95% 2.61-8.93), da cutar sankarar jini (aHR 5.90, 95% CI 2.87-12.1).
Northern Sotho: Bong bja bonna bo be bo amantšhwa le dikelo tša godimo tša kankere ya dišo tša ka fase ga letlalo (aHR 2.06, 95% CI 1.61-2.63), kankere ye e sa hlaselego mašole a mmele (aHR 3.17, 95% CI 2.06-4.89), kankere ya go hlasela mašole a mmele (aHR 4.83, 95% 2.61-8.93), le kankere ya madi (aHR 5.90, 95% CI 2.87-12.1).
Amharic: የወንድ ጾታ ከከፍተኛ የካፓሲ ሳርኮማ ምጥነቶች ጋር የተቆራኘ ሲሆን (የ.አ.መ 2.06, 95% CI 1.61-2.63)፣ ናን ሆድጅኪን ሊምፎማ ደግሞ (የ.አ.መ 3.17, 95% CI 2.06-4.89)፣ ሆድጅኪን ሊምፎማ (የ.አ.መ 4.83, 95% 2.61-8.93)፣ እና ሉኪሚያ

English: Lower CD4 cell counts at baseline were associated with higher rates of Kaposi sarcoma, cervical cancer, non-Hodgkin and Hodgkin lymphoma.
Luganda: Omuwendo gw’obutaffaali bwa CD4 omutono ku ntandikwa gwakwanyizibwa n’omuwendo ogwa waggulu ogwa Kaposi sarcoma, kookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana, non-Hodgkin ne Hodgkin lymphoma.
Yoruba: CD4 tó kéré ní ipò-ìpìlẹ̀ ní Kaposi sakóma lọ́pọ̀, jẹjẹrẹ òbò, aláìní-ọjigin lìkómà àti ọjigin lìkómà.
Zulu: Amasosha e-CD4 aphansi ahlangene nezibalo eziphezulu ze-Kaposi sakhoma, umdlavuza wesibeletho, ne-non-Hodgkin ne-Hodgkin limfoma.
Hausa: Ƙananan kididdigar tantanin halitta na CD4 na da alaqa da yawan kamuwa da Kaposi sarkoma, ciwon dajin mahaifa, limfoma wanda ba na Hodgkin ba da limfomar Hodgkin.
Northern Sotho: Dikelo tša fasana tša disele tša CD4 go kelo ya motheo di be di amantšhwa le dikelo tša godimo tša kankere ya dišo tša ka fase ga letlalo, kankere ya molomo wa popelo, kankere ye e sa hlaselego mašole a mmele le kankere ye e hlaselago mašole a mmele.
Amharic: በመነሻ ደረጃ አነስተኛ የሲዲ4 ሴል ቁጥሮች ከከፍተኛ የካፖሲ ሳርኮማ፣ የማህጸን በር ካንሰር፣ ናን ሆድጅኪን እና ሆድጅኪን ሊምፎማ ጋር ተቆራኝተው ነበር፡፡

English: The burden of these cancers may be reduced through HPV vaccination, targeted HIV testing, early initiation of antiretroviral therapy, and improvement of treatment adherence.
Luganda: Obulabe bwa kookolo ono busobola okukendeezebwa okuyita mu kugema ne HPV, okukeberwa HIV, okutandika amangu eddagala eriweweeza ku HIV, n’okulaba ng’abantu bongera okwettanira obujjanjabi.
Yoruba: Ìnira àwọn jẹjẹrẹ yìí lè di dídínkù nípa àbẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára HPV, àyẹ̀wò tó fojú sun HIV, ìmúwọlé ìtọ́jú ara ajẹmọ́-ìdèènà ààrùn, àti ìmúgbéga bá ìtọ́jú tó yẹ.
Zulu: Umthwalo walemidlavuza ungehliswa ngomgomo we-HPV, ukuhlolela i-HIV okunenhloso, ukuqala imishanguzo masinya, nokuthatha imishanguzo ngendlela.
Hausa: Za a iya rage matsalar waɗannan ciwon daji ta hanyar rigakafin HPV, gwajin HIV na musamman, fara maganin cutar qanjamau da wuri, da gyara kula da jiyya.
Northern Sotho: Bošoro bja dikankere tše bo ka fokotšwa ka tsela ya moento wa HPV, diteko tša HIV tše di nepilwego, go thomiša ka go nwa dihlare tša anthiretherobaerale ka potlako, le kaonafatšo ya go obamela kalafo.
Amharic: የእነዚህ ካንሰሮች ሸክም በኤችቢቪ ክትባት፣ በታለመ የኤችአይቪ ምርመራ፣ ጸረ-ኤችአይቪ ህክምና ቀድሞ በመጀመር እና የህክምና ክትትልን በማሻሻል ሊቀንስ ይችላል፡፡

English: South African youth with HIV and low CD4 counts at higher risk of cancer
Luganda: Abavubuka b’e South Afirika abalina HIV ne CD4 entono bali mu bulabe obw’amaanyi obw’okufuna kookolo
Yoruba: Àwọn ọ̀dọ́ orílẹ̀-èdè South Africa tí ó ní HIV àti CD4 tó kéré súmọ́ ewu àtiní jẹjẹrẹ gidi gan-an.

Hausa: Matasan Afirka ta Kudu masu HIV da ƙananan CD4 suna da haɗarin kamuwa da cutar daji
Northern Sotho: Baswa ba Afrika Borwa bao ba nago le HIV le dikelo tša fase tša CD4 ba kotsing ya godimo ya kankere
Amharic: ለካንሰር የመጋለጥ አደጋቸው ከፍተኛ የሆነ አነስተኛ የሲዲ4 ቁጥር እና ኤችአይቪ ያለበቻው የደቡብ አፍሪካ ወጣቶች

English: People living with HIV between the ages of 15 and 24 who have a low CD4 count have a higher risk of cancer, especially cancers caused by viral infections that target a weak immune system.
Luganda: Abantu abalina HIV abali wakati w’emyaka 15 ne 24 nga balina CD4 ntono balina obulabe bwa maanyi obw’okufuna kookolo, naddala kookolo aleetebwa obuwuka obulumba abantu ab’obusibage obunafu.
Yoruba: Àwọn ènìyàn tí ó ń gbé pẹ̀lú HIV láàrin ọjọ́ orí 15 sí 24 tí ó ní CD4 tó kéré súmọ́ ewu àtiní jẹjẹrẹ gidi gan-an, pàápàá jùlọ jẹjẹrẹ tí kòkòkò fáírọ́sì ń fà tí ó ń lépa àti sọ adèènà-àrùn ara di aláìlágbára.
Zulu: Abantu abaphila ne-HIV abaphakathi kweminyaka ewu-15 no-24 abanesibalo samasosha e-CD4 aphansi basegcupheni yokuthola umdlavuza, ikakhulukazi imidlavuza edalwa izifo ezidalwa igciwane ezihlasela amasosha omzimba.
Hausa: Mutanen da ke dauke da kwayar cuta mai karya garkuwar jiki HIV masu tsakanin shekaru 15 zuwa 24 waxanda ke da qarancin CD4 suna da haxarin kamuwa da cutar daji, musamman cututtukan daji da ke haifar da gwayoyin cutuka da ke kama garkuwar jiki da ba shi qarfi.
Northern Sotho: Batho bao ba phelago ka HIV ba mengwaga ya magareng ga ye 15 le 24 bao ba nago le kelo ya fase ya CD4 ba kotsing ya godimo ya go ba le kankere, kudukudu dikankere tše di bakwago ke diphetetšo tša baerase tšeo di hlaselago mašole a mmele ao a fokolago.
Amharic: ከ15 እስከ 24 እድሜ ክልል ውስጥ ያሉ አነስተኛ የሲዲ4 ቁጥር ያላቸው እና ከኤችአይቪ ጋር የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ለካንሰር የመጋለጥ እድላቸው ከፍተኛ ነው፤ በተለይም የደከሙ ኢሚዩን ሲስተሞችን በሚያጠቁ የቫይረስ ኢንፌክሽኖች ለሚከሰቱ ካንሰሮች ተጋላጭ ናቸው፡፡

English: Researchers recommend screening HIV positive youth for cervical cancer, as well as vaccinating youth against HPV (human papillomavirus, which causes cervical cancer).
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bateesa okukebera kookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana mu bavubuka abalina HIV, awamu n’okubagema akawuka ka HPV (human papillomavirus, akaleeta kookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana).
Yoruba: Àwọn Aṣèwádìí dábàá ṣíṣe àyẹ̀wò jẹjẹrẹ òbò fún àwọn ọ̀dọ́ tí wọ́n ní ààrùn HIV, bákan náà fífún àwọn ọ̀dọ́ ní abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára láti dèènà HPV (fairọ̀sì- papilóma èèyàn, tí ó ń fa jẹjẹrẹ òbò).
Zulu: Abacwaningi bacebisa ukuthi kumele intsha ene-HIV ihlolele umdlavuza wesibeletho, nokuthi igome umgomo we-HPV(huma papillomavirus edala umdlavuza wesibeletho).
Hausa: Masu bincike sun ba da shawarar auna matasa masu HIV don cutar daji ta mahaifa, da kuma yi wa matasa allurar rigakafin HPV (cutar papillomavirus, wanda ke haifar da cutar daji ta mahaifa).
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba šišinya gore baswa bao ba nago le HIV ba dirwe tlhahlobo ya kankere ya molomo wa popelo, gammogo le go hlabela baswa moento wa HPV (human papillomavirus, ye e bakago kankere ya molomo wa popelo).
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ኤችአይቪ ፖዘቲዝ የሆኑ ወጣቶችን ለማህጸን በር ካንሰር መመርመር እና የማህጸን በር ካንሰር ለሚያስከስተው ለኤችቢቪ ወይም ለሂዩማን ፓፒሎማ ቫይረስ መከተብ እንደሚያስፈልግ ይመክራሉ፡፡

English: They also encourage more HIV testing and starting regular antiretroviral therapy as soon as possible to try and prevent cancers caused by infections due to a weakened immune system.
Luganda: Era bateesa eky’okwongera okukebera HIV n’okutandika eddagala eriweweeza ku HIV amangu ddala nga bwe kisoboka okugezaako okwewala kookolo aleetebwa obuwuka obulumba abalina obusibage obunafu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún gba ìyànjú àyẹ̀wò HIV púpọ̀ síi àti bíbẹ̀ẹ̀rẹ̀ ìtọ́jú lọ́wọ́ fáírọ́sì-àǹtìrítíró ní kété tí ó bá ti yá látì gbìyàjú àti dèènà jẹjẹrẹ tí àwọn ààrùn ń fà látàri àìlágbára adèènà-àrù.
Zulu: Bagqugquzela nnokwengezwa kokuhlolela i-HIV nokuqala imishanguzo yegciwane ngokushesha ukuze kuzanywe ukugwema imidlavuza edalwa ukugula okudalwa amasoshaomzimba abuthaka.
Hausa: Hakanan suna ƙarfafa ƙarin gwajin cutar HIV da fara maganin rigakafi na yau da kullun da wuri-wuri don gwadawa da rigakafin cututtukan daji da ke haifar da cututtuka saboda raunin tsarin rigakafi.
Northern Sotho: Ba hlohleletša le gore go dirwe diteko tše dingwe tša HIV le go thomiša ka dihlare tša anthiretherobaerale ka mehla ka ponyo ya leihlo go leka le go thibela dikankere tše di hlolwago ke diphetetšo ka lebaka la mašole a mmele ao a fokolago.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም የበለጠ የኤችአይቪ ምርመራዎችን ማድረግ፣ በተዳከመ የኢሚዩን ሲስተም ምክንያት በቫይረስ ኢንፌክሽኖች የሚፈጠሩ ካንሰሮችን ለመከላከል እና በተቻለ ፍጥነት መደበኛ የጸረ- ኤችአይቪ ህክምና ማድረግን ያበረታታሉ፡፡

English: HIV infection among the youth is a big health problem in South Africa.
Luganda: Okubeera ne HIV mu bavubuka kizibu kinene mu South Afirika.
Yoruba: Ààrùn HIV láàrin àwọn ọ̀dọ́ jẹ́ ìṣòro ńlá ní orílẹ̀-èdè South Africa.
Zulu: Ukutheleleka nge-HIV ebantwini abasha kuyinkinga yezempilo enkulu eNingizimu Afrika.
Hausa: Cuta mai karya garkuwan jiki HIV a tsakanin matasa babbar matsala ce ta kiwon lafiya a Afirka ta Kudu.
Northern Sotho: Phetetšo ya HIV magareng ga baswa ke bothata bjo bogolo bja maphelo ka Afrika Borwa.
Amharic: በደቡብ አፍሪካ ወጣቶች የኤችአይቪ ኢንፌክሽን ትልቅ የጤና አደጋ ነው፡፡

English: Scientists already know that people living with HIV are at a higher risk of cancer, but they haven't looked much into cancer cases in youth specifically.
Luganda: Bannasaayansi bakimanyi nti abantu abalina HIV bali mu buzibu bwa maanyi obw’okufuna kookolo, naye tebannaba kutunula nnyo ku kookolo mu bavubuka.
Yoruba: Àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ńsì ti mọ̀ pé àwọn tí wọn ń gbé pẹ̀lú kòkòrò HIV wà nínú ewu àti ní jẹjẹrẹ gan-an, ṣùgbọ́n wọn kò tíi wo okùnfà jẹjẹrẹ láàrín àwọn ọ̀dọ́ ní pàtàkì.
Zulu: Osossayensi sebeyazi ukuthi abantu abaphila ne-HIV basengcupheni yomdlavuza, kodwa abakazibhekisisi izigameko zomdlavuza ebantwini abasebasha.
Hausa: Masana kimiyya sun riga sun san cewa mutanen da ke ɗauke da HIV suna cikin haɗarin kamuwa da cutar daji, amma ba su yi nazari sosai game da cutar daji a cikin matasa ba.
Northern Sotho: Ditsebi tša mahlale di šetše di tseba gore batho bao ba phelago ka HIV ba kotsing ye kgolo ya go ba le kankere, eupša ga se ba lebelela go tsenelela mabapi le malwetši a kankere go baswa kudukudu.
Amharic: ሳይንቲስቶች ከኤችአይቪ ጋር የሚኖሩ ሰዎች በካንሰር የመያዝ እድላቸው ከፍተኛ እንደሆነ ያውቃሉ፤ ነገር ግን በተለየ መልኩ በወጣቱ መሃል ያሉ የካንሰር ክስተቶችን አልዳሰሱም፡፡

English: In this study, the researchers wanted to see how many HIV positive youths also had cancer, and what the risk factors might be for different kinds of cancers.
Luganda: Mu kuoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baayagala okulaba abavubuka abalina HIV bameka era abalina kookolo, na nsonga ki eziviirako okufuna ebika bya kookolo eby’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Ní inú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, àwọn aṣèwádìí fẹ́ wo iye ọ̀dọ́ mélòó ni ó ní HIV tí ó sì tún ní jẹjẹrẹ, àti bí ewu náà ṣe lè rí fún oríṣiríṣi àwọn jẹjẹrẹ.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bebefuna ukubona ukuthi ingaki intsha ene-HIV enomdlavuza, nokuthi ibuphi ubungozi obukhona bezinhlobo zemidlavuza.
Hausa: A cikin wannan binciken, masu binciken sun so ganin matasa nawa da suke da cutar HIV suke da ciwon daji, da kuma abubuwan da ke iya haifar da kamuwa da cutukan daji daban-daban.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go bona gore ke baswa ba bakae bao ba nago le HIV bao ba bilego le kankere, le gore go ka hlaga dika dife tše kotsi go mehuta ye e fapafapanego ya dikankere.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎቹ ኤችአይቪ ፖዘቲቭ የሆኑ ምን ያህል ወጣቶች ካንሰር እንዳለባቸው እና በተለያዩ የካንሰር አይነቶች የመያዝ አደጋ መንስኤዎች ምን እንደሆኑ ማየት ፈልገው ነበር፡፡

English: They looked through specific South African patient records of people aged between 15 and 24, between the years 2004 and 2014.
Luganda: Baatunuulira ebiwandiiko by’abalwadde mu South Afirika eby’abantu ab’emyaka 15 ne 24, wakati w’emyaka 2004 ne 2014.
Yoruba: Wọ́n wò àwọn àkọsílẹ̀ àwọn aláìsàn láàrin ọjọ́-orí 15 àti 24 kan ní pàtó ní South Africa láàrin ọdún 2004 àti 2014.
Zulu: Babheke amarakhodi eziguli ezithize eNingizimu Afrika ezineminyaka ephakathi kuka-15 no-24, phakathi kuka-2004 no-2014.
Hausa: Sun bincika takamaiman bayanan marasa lafiya na Afirka ta Kudu na mutanen da ke tsakanin shekara 15 zuwa 24, tsakanin shekarun 2004 da 2014.
Northern Sotho: Ba lekodišišitše dipego tše itšego tša balwetši ba Afrika Borwa tša batho ba mengwaga ya magareng ga ye 15 le 24, mengwageng ya magareng ga 2004 le 2014.
Amharic: ከ2004 እስከ 2014 ከ15 እስከ 24 ዓመት የእድሜ ክልል ውስጥ ያሉ የተወሰኑ የደቡብ አፍሪካ ታማሚ ሰዎችን ሪኮርድ ዳሰዋል፡፡

English: They looked for links between different cancers and, for example, the sex, age, and CD4 cell count of the patients.
Luganda: Baatunuulira akakwate wakati wa kookolo ow’ebika eby’enjawulo n’ebintu nga ekikula, emyaka, n’omuwendo gw’obutaffaali bwa CD4 eby’abalwadde.
Yoruba: Wọ́n wo àsopọ̀ láàrin oríṣiríṣi àwọn jẹjẹrẹ àti, fún àpẹẹrẹ, ẹ̀yà-ìbí, ọjọ́-orí, àti iye kuulu-ẹ̀jẹ̀-CD4 aláìsàn náà.
Zulu: Bebheke ukuxhumana phakathi kwemidlavuza ehlukene, nobulili, iminyaka, nesibalo samasosha e-CD4 seziguli.
Hausa: Sun nemi alaƙa tsakanin nau'ikan ciwon daji daban-daban da, alal misali, jima'i, shekaru, da ƙididdigar ƙwayoyin CD4 na marasa lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Ba lebeletše dikamano magareng ga dikankere tša go fapafapana le, mohlala, bong, mengwaga, le kelo ya disele tša CD4 tša balwetši.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ የታማሚዎቹ ጾታ፣ እድሜ እና የሲዲ4 ቁጥር ከካንሰሮች ጋር ያላቸውን ግንኙነት ዳሰዋል፡፡

English: The researchers report that Kaposi sarcoma was the most common cancer, followed by non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma, Hodgkin’s lymphoma, cervical cancer, and leukaemia.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bagamba nti Kaposi sarcoma ye kookolo eyasinga okusangibwa, ne kuddako non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma, Hodgkin’s lymphoma, kookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana, ne kookolo w’omu musaayi.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà jábọ̀ pé Kaposi sakóma ni jẹjẹrẹ tó wọ́pọ̀ jùlọ, àtẹ̀lé ni aláìní-ọjigin lìkómà, ọjigin lìkómà, jẹjẹjẹ òbò, àti lukémíà.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babika ukuthi i-Kaposi sakhoma iwona mdlavuza obuvamile, ilandelwe i-non- Hodgkin’s limfoma, i-Hodgkin’s limfoma, umdlavuza wesibeletho, nomdlavuza wegazi.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun bayar da rahoton cewa Kaposi sarkoma shi ne ciwon daji da aka fi samu, sai kuma limpoma wanda ba na Hodgkin, limpoma na Hodgkin, ciwon dajin mahaifa, da kuma cutar sankarar jini.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bega gore kankere ya dišo tša ka fase ga letlalo e bile kankere ye e hlagilego kudu, ya latelwa ke kankere ye e sa hlaselego mašole a mmele, kankere ya go hlasela mašole a mmele, kankere ya molomo wa popelo, le kankere ya madi.
Amharic: ከናን ሆድጅኪንስ ሊምፎማ፣ ሆድጅኪንስ ሊምፎማ ፣ ከማህጸን በር ካንሰር እና ሉኪሚያ  ቀጥሎ ተመራማሪዎቹ እንደዘገቡት ካፖሲ ሳርኮማ በጣም የተለመደው የካንሰር አይነት ነበር፡፡

English: They think Kaposi sarcoma, which is caused by a viral infection, was most common because fewer youths are on HIV treatment.
Luganda: Balowooza nti Kaposi sarcoma, ng’ono aleetebwa kawuka, ye yasinga okusangibwa kubanga abavubuka batono abali ku ddagala lya HIV.
Yoruba: Wọ́n rò pé Kaposi sakóma, tí ààrùn kòkòrò fáírọ́sì ń fà, ni ó pọ̀jù torí pé púpọ̀ nínú àwọn ọ̀dọ́ ni wọ́n wà lábẹ́ ìtọ́jú HIV.
Zulu: Bacabanga ukuthi i-Kaposi sakhoma, edalwa ukuthola igciwane, ibingavamile ngoba immbalwa intsha edla imshanguzo ye-HIV.
Hausa: SSuna tsammanin Kaposi sarkoma, wanda kamuwa da cuta ke haifarwa, ya fi yawa saboda matasa kaɗan ne ke yin maganin cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Ba nagana gore kankere ya dišo tša ka fase ga letlalo, ye e hlolwago ke phetetšo ya baerase, e bile ye e hlagilego kudu ka gore ga se baswa ba bantši bao ba nwago dihlare tša HIV.
Amharic: የኤችአይቪ ህክምና የሚያገኙት አነስተኛ ቁጥር ያላቸው ወጣቶች ስለሆኑ በቫይረስ ኢንፌክሽን ምክንያት የሚከሰተው ካፖሲ ሳርኮማ በጣም የተለመደ ነው ብለው ያስባሉ፡፡

English: People with HIV who are not on treatment may have weaker immune systems unable to fight a viral infection.
Luganda: Abantu abalina HIV nga tebali ku ddagala bayinza okuba nga balina obusibage butono obutasobola kulwanyisa buwuka.
Yoruba: Púpọ̀ nínú àwọn ọ̀dọ́ tí wọn kò sí lábẹ́ ìtọ́jú HIV lè ní adèènà-ààrùn aláìlágbára láti lè bá kòkòrò fáírọ́sì náà wọ̀yá ìjà.
Zulu: Abantu abane-HIV abangayidli imidhsnguzo bangaba namasosha omzimba abuthaka angakwazi ukulwa negciwane.
Hausa: Mutanen da ke xauke da qwayar cuta mai karya garkuwar jiki HIV waxanda ba su da magani na iya samun raunin tsarin garkuwar jiki wanda ba zai iya yakar kamuwa da kwayar cuta ba.
Northern Sotho: Batho ba ba swerwego ke HIV bao sa ba nwego dihlare ba ka ba le mašole a mmele ao a fokolago a go palelwa ke go lwantšha phetetšo ya baerase.
Amharic: ኤችአይቪ ያለባቸው እና ህክምና የማያገኙ ሰዎች የተዳከ ኢሚዩን ሲስተም ሊኖራቸው ይችላል በዚህም ምክንያት የቫይረስ ኢንፌክሽንን መቋቋም አይችሉም፡፡

English: The researchers also found that the risk of developing cancer was higher in people aged 20 to 24 than in people aged 15 to 19.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baakizuula nti obulabe bw’okufuna kookolo bwali bungi mu bantu ab’emyaka 20 ku 24 okusinga ku b’emyaka 15 ku 19.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà tún ṣàwárí pé ewu àtijẹ jẹjẹrẹ yọ gbé sókè láàrin àwọn ènìyàn ọjọ́-orí 20 sí 24 ju àwọn ènìyàn ọjọ́-orí 15 sí 19 lọ.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathole nokuthi amathuba okuba nomdlavuza abephezulu kwabaneminyaka ewu-20 kuya ku-24 ukudlula abano-15 kuya ku-19.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma gano cewa haxarin kamuwa da cutar daji ya fi yawa cikin mutane masu shekaru 20 zuwa 24 fiye da masu shekaru 15 zuwa 19.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hweditše le gore kotsi ya go gakala ga kankere e bile godimo go batho ba mengwaga ye 20 go fihla go 24 go feta go batho ba mengwaga ye 15 go fihla go ye 19.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በተጨማሪ ከ 20 እስከ 24 እድሜ ክልል ውስጥ ያሉ ሰዎች ከ15 እስከ 19 ዓመት እድሜ ክልል ውስጥ ካሉት ጋር ሲነጻጻሩ በካንሰር የመያዝ እድላቸው ከፍተኛ ነው፡፡

English: For example, they found that more individuals aged between 20-24 developed non-cervical carcinoma, cervical cancer and Kaposi sarcoma.
Luganda: Okugeza, baakizuula nti abantu bangi ab’emyaka 20-24 baafuna non-cervical carcinoma, kookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana ne Kaposi sarcoma.
Yoruba: Fún bí àpẹẹre, wọ́n ṣàwárí pé púpọ̀ àwọn ẹ̀dá láàrin ọjọ́-orí 20-24 jẹ jẹjẹrẹ kasinómà tí kò jẹ mọ́ òbò yọ àti Kaposi sakóma.
Zulu: Isibonelo, bathole ukuthi abaningi abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-20-24 baqalwe i-non-cervical carcinoma (umdlavuza okhula ezithweni ezingaphakathi) umdlavuza wesibeletho ne-Kaposi sakhoma.
Hausa: Misali, sun gano cewa mutane da yawa masu shekaru tsakanin 20-24 sun kamu da cutar daji wanda ba na mahaifa ba, ciwon daji na mahaifa da kuma Kaposi sarkoma.
Northern Sotho: Mohlala, ba hweditše gore bontši bja batho ba mengwaga ya magareng ga ye 20-24 ba bile le kankere ye e sego ya molomo wa popelo, kankere ya molomo wa popelo le kankere ya dišo tša ka fase ga letlalo.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ፣ ከ20 እስከ 24 እድሜ ክልል ውስጥ ያሉ ብዙ ሰዎች በናን ሰርቪካል ካርሲኖማ፣ በማህጸን በር ካንሰር እና በካፖሲ ሳርኮማ እንደተያዙ ደርሰውበታል፡፡

English: Their results also showed that males had higher incidence rates of any cancer because only 11% of males did not have cancer.
Luganda: Bye baazuula era byalaga nti abasajja be baali basinga okufuna ebika bya kookolo byonna kubanga ebitundu 11% byokka eby’abasajja be bataalina kookolo.
Yoruba: Èsì wọn tún fi hàn pé àwọn ọkùnrin ni iye ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ oríṣiríṣi jẹjẹrẹ tó pọ̀ púpọ̀ nítorí pé 11% àwọn ọkùnrin ni kò ní jẹjẹrẹ.
Zulu: Imiphumela iveze nokuthi abesilisa basemathubeni aphezulu okuthola umdlavuza ngoba u-11% kuphela kubo obungenamdlavuza.
Hausa: Sakamakonsu ya kuma nuna cewa maza suna da yawan kamuwa da ko wace cutar daji saboda kashi 11% na maza ba su da ciwon daji.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tša bona le tšona di bontšhitše gore banna ba bile le dikelo tša godimo tša malwetši afe goba afe a go amana le kankere ka gore ke fela 11% tša banna bao ba bego ba se na kankere.
Amharic: በተጨማሪ ውጤቶቻቸው ወንዶች ከፍተኛ የካንሰር መከሰት ምጥነትን እንዳሳዩ ይጠቁማል ምክንያቱም 11% ወንዶች ብቻ ካንሰር ስለሌላቸው።

English: The researchers report that except for leukaemia, a lower CD4 cell count was linked to higher rates of all cancers, especially Kaposi sarcoma.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bagamba nti ng’oggyeeko kookolo w’omu musaayi, omuwendo gwa CD4 ogwa wansi gwakwanyizibwa n’omuwendo ogwa waggulu ogw’ebika bya kookolo byonna, naddala Kaposi sarcoma.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí jábọ̀ pé àfi lukémíà nìkan, CD4 tó kéré jẹ́ títọpa bá iye jẹ́ ṣíso pọ̀ mọ́ ìwọ́pọ̀ jẹjẹrẹ, pàápàá jùlọ Kaposi sakóma.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babika ukuthi ngaphandle kwe-lukhimya(umdlavuza wegazi), isibalo samasosha e-CD4 besihlangene ezibalweni eziphezulu zayo yonke imidlavuza, ikakhulukazi i-Kaposi sakhoma.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun bayar da rahoton cewa, in ban da cutar sankarar jini, ƙananan ƙwayoyin CD4 suna da alaƙa da haɓakar duk cututtukan daji, musamman Kaposi sarkoma.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bega gore ka ntle ga kankere ya madi, kelo ya fasana ya sele ya CD4 e be e amantšhwa le dikelo tša godimo tša dikankere ka moka, kudukudu kankere ya dišo tša ka fase ga letlalo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ሪፖርት እንዳደረጉት ከሉኪሚያ በስተቀር  አነስተኛ የሲዲ4 ሴል ቁጥር በተለይም ከካፖሲ ሳርኮማ እና ከሁሉም ሌሎች የካንስር አይነቶች ከፍተኛ ምጥነት ጋር ይቆራኛል፡፡

English: They observed slightly higher CD4 cell counts in those aged 15-19 compared to those aged 20-24.
Luganda: Baazuula omuwendo gwa CD4 ogusingako mu abo ab’emyaka 15-19 bw’ogeraageranya n’abo ab’emyaka 20-24.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣàkíyèsí CD4 tó ga díẹ̀ síi nínú àwọn ọjọ́ orí 15-19 yàtọ̀ sí ọjọ́-orí 20-24.
Zulu: Babone izibalo zamasosha e-CD4 ezithe ukukhuphuka kancane kwabaneminyaka ewu-15-19 uma kuqhathaniswa nabano-20-24.
Hausa: Sun lura da ƙidayar ƙwayoyin CD4 kaɗan a cikin waɗanda shekarunsu suka wuce 15-19 idan aka kwatanta da waɗanda shekarunsu suka kai 20-24.
Northern Sotho: Ba lemogile dikelo tša godingwana tša disele tša CD4 go bao ba bego ba na le mengwaga ye 15-19 ge go bapetšwa le bao ba bego ba na le mengwaga ye 20-24.
Amharic: ከ20 እስከ 24 ዓመት ካሉት ሰዎች ጋር ሲነጻጸሩ  ከ15 እስከ 19 ዓመት ያሉት ሰዎች የሲደ4 ሴል ቁጥራቸው  በትንሹ  ከፍ እንደሚል አስተውለዋል፡፡

English: This was the first large study to assess cancer risk among HIV positive youth across South Africa.
Luganda: Kuno kwe kunoonyereza okunene okwasooka nga kwetegereza obulabe bw’okufuna kookolo mu bavubuka abalina HIV mu South Afirika.
Yoruba: Èyí ni iṣẹ́ àkọ́kọ́ tó gbòòrò tí yóò wo ewu jẹjẹrẹ láàrin àwọn tí ó ní ààrun HIV káàkiri orílẹ̀-èdè South Africa.
Zulu: Lolu bekuwucwaningo olukhulu lokuqala olubheke ubungozi bomdlavuza kwabasha abane-HIV eNingizimu Afrika.
Hausa: Wannan shi ne babban bincike na farko don tantance haɗarin ciwon daji a tsakanin matasa masu cuta mai karya garkuwar jiki HIV a duk faɗin Afirka ta Kudu.
Northern Sotho: Tše e bile dinyakišišo tša mathomo tše kgolo tša go lekola kotsi ya kankere magareng ga baswa bao ba nago le HIV go kgabaganya Afrika Borwa.
Amharic: ይሄ ኤችአይቪ ፖዘቲቭ የሆኑ ወጣቶች በካንሰር የመያዝ አደጋ መጠንን በደቡብ አፍሪካ ዙሪያ በሰፊው ያጠና የመጀመሪያው ጥናት ነው

English: But despite having looked at nearly 800 000 patient records, the researchers said the numbers for specific cancer types were small.
Luganda: Naye newankubadde baatunuulira ebiwandiiko by’abalwadde ebikunukkiriza mu 800 000, abanoonyereza baagamba nti emiwendo gy’ebika bya kookolo kinnakimu gyali mitono.
Yoruba: Ṣùgbọ́n pẹ̀lú bí ó ṣe wo àkọsílẹ̀ àwọn aláìsàn 800 000, àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé iye oríṣìí àwọn jẹjẹrẹ kọ̀ọ̀kan kéré.
Zulu: Kodwa ngale kokubheka amarekhodi eziguli acishe abe u-800 000, abacwaningi bathe izibalo zemidlavuza ethize bezim’balwa.
Hausa: Amma duk da duba bayanan marasa lafiya kusan 800 000, masu binciken sun ce adadin takamaiman nau'in ciwon daji kaɗan ne.
Northern Sotho: Eupša ka ntle ga go lebelela dipego tša balwetši bao e ka bago ba 800 000, banyakišiši ba boletše gore dipalopalo tša mehuta ye e itšego ya dikankere di be di le tše nnyane.
Amharic: 800 000 ገደማ የሚደርሱ የታማሚ ሪኮርዶችን ቢዳስሱም እንኳ ተመራማሪዎቹ የተወሰኑ የካንሰር አይነቶች ቁጥር አነስተኛ ነበር ብለዋል፡፡

English: They also said that they could not get some of the patient information they needed.
Luganda: Era baagamba nti waliwo ebikwata ku balwadde ebimu bye baali beetaaga bye bataafuna.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún sọ pé àwọn kò rí àwọn àlàyé tó wúlò mìíran àwọn aláìsàn gbà.
Zulu: Baphinde bathi abakwazanga ukuthole eminye imininingwane yeziguli abebeyifuna.
Hausa: Sun kuma ce ba za su iya samun wasu bayanan majiyyatan da suke bukata ba.
Northern Sotho: Gape ba boletše gore ba paletšwe ke go hwetša tshedimošo ye nngwe ya balwetši yeo ba bego ba e hloka.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም የፈለጉትን የአንዳንድ ታማሚዎች መረጃ ማግኘት እንዳልቻሉ ገልጸዋል፡፡

English: They cautioned other researchers may have used different ways to define occurrences of cancer, so these results might not compare easily to others.
Luganda: Baalabula nti abanoonyereza abalala bayinza okuba nga baakozesa enkola endala okulaga okubeerawo kwa kookolo, nga noolwekyo ebyazuulibwa mu kunoonyereza kuno biyinza okuba nga tebigeraageranyizika mangu na birala.
Yoruba: Wọ́n kìlọ̀ pé àwọn aṣèwádìí mìíràn lè ti lo àwọn ọ̀nà mìíràn láti sọ ọ̀nà ìwáyé jẹjẹrẹ, nítorí náà àwọn èsì náà lè má rọrùn láti fi wé àwọn mìíràn.
Zulu: Baqwashise ukuthi abanye abacwaningi kungenzeka basebenzisa ezinye izindlela zokuchaza a ukuvela komdlavuza, ngalokho lemiphumela ingeqhathaniseke neminye.
Hausa: Sun yi gargaxin cewa wasu masu bincike na iya amfani da hanyoyi daban-daban don ayyana abubuwan da ke faruwa na ciwon daji, don haka ba za a iya kwatanta waɗannan sakamakon cikin sauƙi da sauran ba.
Northern Sotho: Ba lemošitše gore banyakišiši ba bangwe ba ka ba ba šomišitše ditsela tše di fapafapanego go hlaloša ditiragalo tša kankere, ka gona dipoelo di ka se bapetšwe gabonolo le tše dingwe.
Amharic: ሌሎች ተመራማሪዎች የካንሰር ክስተቶችን ለመለየት የተለዩ ዘዴዎችን ሊጠቀሙ እንደሚችሉ አሳስበዋል፤ በዚህም ምክንያት እነዚህ ውጤቶች ከሌሎች ውጤቶች ጋር በቀላሉ መወዳደር አይችሉ ይሆናል፡፡
